segments.content_text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Python is an open-source library for developers using Python. It reads Compound File Binary (CFB) files and Outlook .MSG files and writes Compound File Binary (CFB) files, Outlook .MSG files, and email.message.EmailMessage (.eml) files.

- [Key Capabilities](#key-capabilities)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Quick Start](#quick-start)
- [Additional Examples](#additional-examples)
- [API Reference](#api-reference)
- [Documentation and Resources](#documentation-and-resources)
- [Scope and Limitations](#scope-and-limitations)
- [Development and Testing](#development-and-testing)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [Security](#security)
- [License](#license)
